```sh
kafka streams-group describe <groupIds...>
```

Describe one or more streams groups

## Arguments

| Argument      | Description                   |
| ------------- | ----------------------------- |
| `groupIds...` | streams group ids to describe |

Shared options and defaults: [connection profiles, JSON output, logging and help](../../../global-options/).

## Defaults

Describes the supplied streams group ids, reporting errors per group. Topology descriptions are read only with --topology-description, which needs Kafka 4.4+.

## Flags

| Flag                     | Description                                                    |
| ------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--brokers <string>`     | comma-separated broker list, e.g. localhost:9092               |
| `--topology-description` | also read each group's topology description (needs Kafka 4.4+) |

## Examples

```sh
kafka streams-group describe word-count --brokers localhost:9092
kafka streams-group describe word-count --topology-description --json
```

## Output

Illustrative, abbreviated output. Empty arrays show the result envelope; actual entries, identifiers, optional fields and broker errors depend on the request and cluster.

With `--json`:

```json
{
  "groups": []
}
```

Declared exit codes: `0`, `1`, `2`, `4`. See the exit-code reference for meanings.
